npc_brea_healer.name: Brea
npc_brea_healer.look: A stout woman in her sixties with rosy cheeks and silver hair in a bun, a dark green wool dress with the sleeves rolled up, a white apron with herb stains, and a leather pouch of herbs at her belt.
npc_brea_healer.personality: Brisk, warm and bossy; has stitched up half the county and takes no nonsense from anyone bleeding on her floor.
npc_brea_healer.values: clean hands, a good night's sleep, people who do as they're told
npc_brea_healer.authority: Mother of the Ford Inn's innkeeper; healer to the inn, the road and the garrison's recruits.
npc_brea_healer.concerns: Patients who won't sit still; the drover Tam, who's careless round her stove.

clean.text: A cut must be kept clean and bound, or it festers.
clean.line: Bind it clean and keep it clean, or you'll be back with a fever.
clean.lead: Keep a cut clean and bound, or it festers.

ulf.text: Ulf the charcoal burner up the river knows fire better than anyone, and boils his water before he drinks it.
ulf.line: Ulf up the river boils his water before he drinks it. Odd man. Never been sick a day.
ulf.lead: Ulf the charcoal burner up the river boils his water before drinking it.

npc_brea_healer.style: Brisk orders with 'dearie' on the end; tuts a lot.

samples: Sit. No, there. Let me see it.
Tch. Clean, at least. You'll live, dearie.
Linen's on the table. Tear it, don't chew it.
If it's hot and red tomorrow, you come straight back.
voice.habits: Gives orders; tuts; calls everyone 'dearie'; names herbs as she goes.
voice.never: lets a wound go untended or gossips about patients
voice.greeting: Peers at you over her spectacles: 'Hurt, or hungry?'

goals: Keep everyone at the inn in one piece
npc_brea_healer.dislikes: dirt in wounds, men who say it's only a scratch

npc_tam_drover.text: a careless lump with a good heart

superstition.text: Brea would want to know how it works.

npc_tam_drover.name: Tam
npc_tam_drover.look: A lean, sunburnt drover in his thirties with a short black beard, a sheepskin vest over a grey shirt, a red bandana round his neck, and dusty boots.
npc_tam_drover.personality: Easy-going and clumsy; laughs at his own scrapes.
npc_tam_drover.values: his cattle, a dry bed, an honest wage
npc_tam_drover.fears: being laid up while the herd moves on
npc_tam_drover.concerns: His herd is waiting at the ford; he wants to be on the road by noon.

ford.text: The ford below the mill is safe to cross in the morning, before the mill opens the race.
ford.line: Cross at the ford before the mill opens the race, or you'll swim.
ford.lead: The ford below the mill is safe in the mornings.

npc_tam_drover.style: Cheerful grumbling; makes light of pain.

samples: Ah, it's nothing. It's a lot of nothing.
Brea'll have my hide for this.
Twenty head of cattle and I trip over a stove.
Thank you kindly. That's better already.
voice.habits: Laughs off pain; thanks people warmly.
voice.greeting: Waves with his good hand: 'Morning! Don't mind me.'

npc_tam_drover.likes: his cattle, ale, a good story

tasks.doing: warming his hands at the stove

superstition.text: Tam would want to know how it works.
